objective.statement: Understand triplet groups that include rests or notes of different lengths.
successCriteria: I know a triplet group can contain rests.
I know a group can hold a crotchet and a quaver instead of three equal notes.
I can check that a group adds up to three units.

explanation.text: A triplet does not always have three notes of the same length. A rest can take the place of one of the notes, and a longer note can stand for two of the three parts.

music.textAlternative: A bar of 2/4: a triplet group of two quavers and a quaver rest, then a crotchet.
music.questionAlternative: Bar 1: a triplet of quaver, quaver, quaver rest, crotchet.

explanation.caption: Two quavers and a quaver rest, all marked 3. The rest is a silent third of the group.

music.textAlternative: A bar of 2/4: a triplet group made of a crotchet and a quaver, then a crotchet.
music.questionAlternative: Bar 1: a triplet of crotchet, quaver, crotchet.

explanation.caption: A crotchet and a quaver, marked 3: the crotchet is two of the three parts. It is still played in the time of one beat.

explanation.text: To check a group, add up the written lengths in units of the smallest note: here the crotchet counts as 2 and the quaver as 1. A complete triplet group adds up to 3 units.
Count in units: 1 for the short note or rest, 2 for the one twice as long. A triplet group always adds up to 3.

music.textAlternative: A bar of 2/4: a triplet group starting with a quaver rest, then two quavers, and a crotchet.
music.questionAlternative: Bar 1: a triplet of quaver rest, quaver, quaver, crotchet.

steps: Count the parts of the group: a rest, a note and a note make three.
The rest is silent, but it still takes its share of the beat.
All three parts together are played in the time of one crotchet beat.

feedback.correct: Yes: a rest is silence, not a note.

mistakes.tuplet-total-wrong: A tuplet still fills a fixed amount of time. Check which beat it replaces.
mistakes.tuplet-number-wrong: Count the notes that share the beat — that's the number to write over the group.
